capabilities: Record audio by holding a hotkey and transcribe it on release
Insert transcribed text at the cursor or copy it to the clipboard
Switch between Deepgram and Groq providers and their models
Choose a transcription language or auto-detect it
Save recordings as WAV files and write activity logs in the vault
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 0.15.0+) and not reviewed by Obsidian staff; audio is sent to Deepgram or Groq cloud APIs, and free tiers with credits are available. Installation is currently from source only.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dictation, so capturing spoken text into a note requires external recording and transcription tools.
summary: Push-to-talk voice transcription plugin that records while a hotkey is held and inserts the transcribed text at the cursor using Deepgram or Groq.
